name: caelo-token
description: Edit a Caelo CMS site from Claude Code with Caelo's local MCP server and a token: for self-hosted, AWS and Azure installs and for CI. Same skills as caelo. A Google Cloud install with remote MCP connects by URL with the caelo plugin instead.

admin_url.title: Caelo admin URL
admin_url.description: Your Caelo admin's address, e.g. https://admin.example.com (https:// required; http:// only for localhost). Leave empty if you have no Caelo install yet.

mcp_token.title: Caelo MCP token (scope power)
mcp_token.description: Mint your own at /settings/mcp on your install: New token, scope power. It acts as you. Shown once; stored in your system keychain.

iap_service_account.title: IAP service account (Google Cloud installs only)
iap_service_account.description: Only for installs on Google Cloud behind IAP: the value /settings/mcp shows for CAELO_IAP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT. Leave empty otherwise.
